parameters.query:
SELECT 
  l.id,
  l.nome,
  l.whatsapp_loja,
  l.connect_token,
  l.ativo,
  l.deleted_at,
  l.config_json,
  l.created_at,
  l.updated_at,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pessoas p WHERE p.loja_id = l.id), 0)::int AS total_contatos,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mensagens m WHERE m.loja_id = l.id), 0)::int AS total_mensagens
FROM lojas l
WHERE ($1::boolean = true OR l.deleted_at IS NULL)
ORDER BY l.id ASC;
